question: What happens when a completed step is renamed mid-flight?
advice: AWS: don't rename steps or change their behaviour in ways that break replay; doing so while executions are in progress means they can fail to resume or produce incorrect results. Both outcomes are named. Which one you get is not. (Lambda dev guide, durable-best-practices)
